author: John Hammond
description:
Attackers don't need a sophisticated lure when excitement does the work for them.

Fake downloads for games like GTA VI, along with cheats and mods, are common ways for infostealer malware to be delivered. Even after an infection, simple commands like whoami can help an attacker understand the system they've compromised.

Watch the full video: https://www.youtube.com/live/hG1imCvG7B8?si=OM2SJ72Mzj5_DKJA
title: GTA Malware Trap
